title: Holographic RG flows and wormholes from sinusoidal scalars
summary: We study semiclassical geometries induced by turning on identical sinusoidal scalar sources on two asymptotic anti-de Sitter (AdS) boundaries. Varying the source strength, we find that large and small wormhole solutions appear beyond a certain threshold. Above this threshold, the large wormhole is always the dominant saddle in the two-boundary gravitational path integral; there is no regime where wormholes are subdominant.
